title: Interlocking concrete pavers: zigzag, dogbone, wavy
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of interlocking concrete pavers in stretcher bond whose curved sides mate exactly: zigzag, dogbone (I shape) or wavy, with chamfers, sand joints, exposed aggregate, tumbled edges and per-paver colour blends. Use for driveways, plazas, sidewalks and parking areas.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python interlocking_pavers.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: shape
parameters.meaning: 0 zigzag sides (two teeth per paver), 1 dogbone or I shape (wide ends, narrow middle), 2 wavy sides (a sine with two waves per paver).

parameters.name: pavers_per_row
parameters.meaning: Pavers across the tile in each row; the tile holds twice as many rows.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.meaning: How far the curved sides swing, in paver widths.

parameters.name: joint_width
parameters.meaning: Sand joint width in paver widths.

parameters.name: chamfer
parameters.meaning: Width of the bevelled top edge in paver widths.

parameters.name: joint_fill
parameters.meaning: Height of the jointing sand relative to the paver tops.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.meaning: Exposed stone aggregate speckling the concrete face.

parameters.name: tumbling
parameters.meaning: Tumbled, rounded and chipped edges of antique-style pavers.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Grey concrete zigzag pavers with light sand joints.

presets.name: red_dogbone
presets.description: Red concrete I-shaped dogbone pavers interlocking in stretcher bond.

presets.name: charcoal_wavy
presets.description: Charcoal wavy pavers with fine aggregate and tight joints.

presets.name: tumbled_blend
presets.description: Tumbled dogbone pavers in a brown, tan and charcoal blend.

limits: Pavers are laid in stretcher bond only; herringbone and basket layouts of interlocking shapes are out of scope. Paver ends are straight and the curved sides follow one periodic curve, a simplification of real paver catalogues. Aggregate, stains and chips are noise approximations. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Row joints as periodic curves shared by both rows (cosine, triangle and sine)
Rows offset by half a paver so wide ends meet narrow middles
Distance to curved sides divided by the slope factor
Per-paver hashing for colour, lippage and tone
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
